FR-001.title: Network entry is not anonymous
FR-001.threat: Anyone on the internet can call this service
FR-001.explanation: {from} can reach {process} without a caller identity.
FR-001.mitigation: Require a caller identity on this flow. Do not grant it to the public.

FR-002.title: Internet-reachable compute has a small instance cap
FR-002.threat: Internet-reachable service can grow without a tight cap
FR-002.explanation: {element} is reachable from the internet and its instance cap is above 10.
FR-002.group_title: {element} can scale without a tight cap
FR-002.mitigation: Set the maximum instance count to 10 or fewer.

FR-003.title: Credentials are not injected through the environment
FR-003.threat: Secret is exposed in the process environment
FR-003.explanation: A secret is injected into {process} as an environment variable.
FR-003.group: {count} secrets are injected through the environment
FR-003.group_title: Secret exposed in the process environment
FR-003.mitigation: Deliver the secret as a mounted file. Do not put it in the process environment.

FR-004.title: Model invocation is scoped to one resource
FR-004.threat: Model access covers every model in the project
FR-004.explanation: {process} can call every model in the project, not only {to}.
FR-004.group_title: Model access covers the whole project
FR-004.mitigation: Grant the caller access to the single model resource.

FR-005.title: Container image is pinned by digest
FR-005.threat: Container image can be replaced without a review
FR-005.explanation: {element} starts from a mutable image tag, so a later start can run different code.

FR-006.title: Secret reads are audit logged
FR-006.threat: Secret reads leave no audit trail
FR-006.explanation: A read of {element} cannot be attributed to a caller.
FR-006.mitigation: Record data-read and data-write access on the secret store.

FR-007.title: Secret use is scoped to one resource
FR-007.threat: Secret access granted at project scope
FR-007.explanation: {process} can now read every secret in the project, including secrets created later.
FR-007.group_title: Secret access widened to the whole project
FR-007.before: Before this change it could read only the {count} secrets it uses.
FR-007.mitigation: Grant access on the individual secret, not on the project or account.

remediations.text: grant `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` on each secret with `google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member`, not on the project.
scope `GetSecretValue` to the secret ARN in `Resource`, not `"*"`.
remediations.explanation: {process} can now read every secret the role can reach, including secrets created later.

remediations.text: scope `GetSecretValue` to the secret ARN in `Resource`, not `"*"`.
remediations.explanation: {process} can now read every secret the role can reach, including secrets created later.

FR-008.title: Secret store cannot be destroyed by the tool
FR-008.threat: Secret store can be destroyed by the infrastructure tool
FR-008.group_title: {element} can be destroyed by the infrastructure tool
FR-008.mitigation: Block destroy of the secret store in the infrastructure tool.

FR-009.title: Secrets are rotated
FR-009.explanation: {element} stays valid indefinitely after it leaks.
FR-009.mitigation: Configure a rotation schedule on the secret.

FR-010.title: Object storage is not public
FR-010.threat: Objects are readable by anyone who can name them
FR-010.explanation: {element} is public, so anyone who knows an object name can read it.
FR-010.mitigation: Keep the bucket private. Do not grant public read.

remediations.text: remove or disable `{cause}`. To share specific objects, use presigned URLs.
remediations.explanation: This enables a public r2.dev URL on {element}. Anyone who knows an object name can read it without credentials.

FR-012.title: Object storage cannot be destroyed by the tool
FR-012.threat: Object storage can be destroyed by the infrastructure tool
FR-012.group_title: {element} can be destroyed by the infrastructure tool
FR-012.mitigation: Block destroy of the bucket in the infrastructure tool.

FR-014.title: Object storage keeps prior versions
FR-014.threat: Overwriting an object drops the previous copy
FR-014.group_title: Overwriting an object drops the previous copy

FR-017.title: LLM processing region is pinned
FR-017.threat: Model processing region is not pinned
FR-017.explanation: Calls to {element} are not pinned to one regional endpoint.
FR-017.group_title: Model processing region is not pinned
FR-017.mitigation: Set the model region to a single regional endpoint, not global.

FR-023.title: Object reads are audit logged
FR-023.threat: Object reads leave no audit trail
FR-023.explanation: A read of {element} cannot be attributed to a caller.
FR-023.mitigation: Record data-read access on the bucket.

FR-024.title: Object storage does not use ACLs
FR-024.threat: Object ACLs can grant access that bucket policy does not show
FR-024.mitigation: Disable object ACLs so only bucket IAM grants access.

FR-025.title: Object storage blocks public access
FR-025.threat: Public access to the bucket is not blocked
FR-025.explanation: {element} can be opened later by a public hostname.
FR-025.group: {count} buckets do not block public access
FR-025.mitigation: Block public access on the bucket.

FR-026.title: Traffic that crosses a trust boundary is encrypted
FR-026.threat: Traffic crosses a trust boundary unencrypted
FR-026.explanation: Traffic from {from} to {to} crosses a trust boundary without TLS.
FR-026.group_title: Traffic crosses a trust boundary unencrypted
